_doc: Free-tier allowances for every premium feature. Versioned in the repo like badges.json and pathways.json, NOT in the DB: these numbers exist to be retuned against what the funnel actually does, and a retune through a migration would be a deploy. plus-api/src/quota.ts loads it, content-refresh.ts re-fetches the published copy every few minutes, so changing a number here is a commit to the site. Nothing about a user lives in this file — every count is derived from data the product already keeps (see plus-api/src/services/quota.ts).

review_cards.exhausted_fa: سه کارتِ امروزت را مرور کردی. فردا سه کارت تازه باز می‌شود — یا با پریمیوم، همین حالا تمام صف.

assistant_runs.exhausted_fa: دو کیسِ این ماهت را پرسیدی. ماه بعد دو تای تازه باز می‌شود — یا با پریمیوم، بدون سقف.

previews._doc: Truncations, not refusals: a free reader always gets an answer here, just less of it. Nothing in this block can ever return an error.
